title: Reinstatement of a TRICARE Prime Enrollment Ended for Nonpayment
content:
A **TRICARE Prime** nonpayment disenrollment is reversed only through an Enrollment Reinstatement Review, a case type of Appeals and Grievances.

## Condition

The enrollment is reinstated only when an Enrollment Reinstatement Review case for this enrollment is decided overturned and every past-due installment through the current period has a payment posted.

- **Evidence:** the Enrollment Reinstatement Review case whose subject is this enrollment, and its decision status; the enrollment's own fee account, for the payments posted against its past-due installments. Both are system records read before the reinstatement is made.
- Both parts must hold together; either one alone does not reinstate.

| Review case for this enrollment | Every past-due installment through the current period has a payment posted | Reinstated |
|---|---|---|
| decided overturned | yes | yes |
| decided overturned | no | no |
| not decided overturned, or no case | yes | no |
| not decided overturned, or no case | no | no |

## Effect

Reinstatement restores the enrollment from the day after the old paid-through date with no gap, the same PCM assignment and the same fee arrangement; claims denied for the gap are reprocessed.

## Requests outside the window

A request made after the tier's reinstatement request window, or without good cause shown, is not a reinstatement and the beneficiary must wait for the open season or a new qualifying life event.

| Tier | Reinstatement request window (calendar days after the nonpayment disenrollment) | Enrolling again after a nonpayment disenrollment, without reinstatement |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | 0 (fee-exempt) | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | 0 (fee-exempt) | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | 90 | at the next open season or after a new qualifying life event |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | 90 | at the next open season or after a new qualifying life event |

**Worked dates (hypothetical).** An enrollment paid through 31 March is disenrolled for nonpayment, the review is decided overturned and every past-due installment has a payment posted: coverage resumes from 1 April with no gap.
